fact: Alleged forcing another driver off of the track.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 2 b) of the International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video and in-car video evidence. Car 27 attempted an overtake on the outside of Car 22 into Turn 1 and had the right to the racing line. Car 22 understeered while trying to defend the position and thereby forced Car 27 off track. However, Car 27 re-joined the track in front of Car 22. The Stewards determine that both contributed to the incident and ended up in the correct order, therefore no further action is taken.
stewards: determine that both contributed to the incident
ended up in the correct order
in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Decision Car 22 Alleged Forcing Another Driver Off Of The Track
to: The Team Manager, Oracle Red Bull Racing
